create_logfire_logger: create a LogfireLogger instance to log LiteLLM events to Logfire with automatic configuration
test_log_event: test the log_event method to log completion, embedding, or image generation calls with info or error level
build_span_config: build a SpanConfig with a message template and span data dictionary for a given payload
